array.string:
ENV_FILE="${ECHODATAFLOW_SERVICES_ENV_FILE:-$HOME/.config/echodataflow/services.env}" [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]] || { echo "Missing $ENV_FILE"; exit 1; }
set -a source "$ENV_FILE" set +a
: "${SMB_USER:?SMB_USER is not set in services.env}" : "${SMB_PASSWORD:?SMB_PASSWORD is not set in services.env}" : "${SMB_HOST:?SMB_HOST is not set in services.env}" : "${SMB_SHARE:?SMB_SHARE is not set in services.env}" : "${SMB_MOUNT_POINT:?SMB_MOUNT_POINT is not set in services.env}"
LOG_DIR="${ECHODATAFLOW_LOG_DIR:-$HOME/.local/log/echodataflow}" mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
exec >>"$LOG_DIR/auto-mount.out.log" 2>&1 "$LOG_DIR/auto-mount.err.log" set -x
echo "$(date): auto mount service started"
mkdir -p "$SMB_MOUNT_POINT"
while true; do if ! /sbin/mount | grep -q "$SMB_MOUNT_POINT"; then echo "$(date): mounting $SMB_MOUNT_POINT"
/sbin/mount_smbfs \ "//${SMB_USER}:${SMB_PASSWORD}@${SMB_HOST}/${SMB_SHARE}" \ "$SMB_MOUNT_POINT"
if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then echo "$(date): mount successful" else echo "$(date): mount failed" fi fi
sleep 300 done
